title: Evolutionary Intelligence: How Coevolution Opened the Way to the AlphaFold Revolution.
authors: Bastolla, Ugo; Aurell, Erik; Cocco, Simona; Liberles, David A; Micheletti, Cristian; Orellana, Laura; Rojas, Ana; Talavera, David; Valencia, Alfonso
one_liner_zh: 该文回顾了从共进化分析到AlphaFold的蛋白质结构预测发展历程，属于综述性讨论，虽涉及AI方法但缺乏新方法贡献。
abstract: The sequences and structures of proteins that exist in nature are a joint product of physical mechanisms and evolutionary processes that are deeply interconnected. It was proposed that physical interactions between amino acids at different protein sites induce evolutionary correlations (co-evolution) between these sites. The inference of these correlations, first as mutual information, then as parameters of a statistical model that describes protein families (direct couplings) and, finally, through the deep neural networks of AlphaFold, produced very powerful developments that revolutionized the field of protein structure and function prediction, providing unprecedented advances in the understanding of proteins and even cells. To discuss the evolutionary mechanisms that produce the correlations exploited by AlphaFold, some of us organized the symposium "Evolutionary intelligence: How coevolution opened the way to the AlphaFold revolution" (Madrid, August 2025), sponsored by the Journal of Molecular Evolution and by the Computational Biology and Bioinformatics (BCB) Hub of the Spanish Research Council (CSIC). The symposium gathered a collection of researchers who contributed to the development and the advancement of the approach based on evolution-induced correlations. This paper represents a collective discussion of part of this community.
abstract_zh: 自然界中存在的蛋白质序列和结构，是物理机制与进化过程深度交织的共同产物。有研究提出，蛋白质不同位点间的物理相互作用会诱导这些位点间的进化相关性（共进化）。对这些相关性的推断，最初以互信息形式呈现，随后作为描述蛋白质家族的统计模型参数（直接耦合），最终通过AlphaFold的深度神经网络实现，催生了极为强大的发展，彻底革新了蛋白质结构与功能预测领域，为理解蛋白质乃至细胞提供了前所未有的进展。为探讨产生AlphaFold所利用的相关性的进化机制，我们中的一些人组织了研讨会“进化智能：共进化如何为AlphaFold革命铺平道路”（马德里，2025年8月），该研讨会由《分子进化杂志》和西班牙研究委员会（CSIC）的计算生物学与生物信息学（BCB）中心赞助。研讨会汇集了一批为基于进化诱导相关性的方法发展及推进做出贡献的研究者。本文代表了该社区部分成员的集体讨论。
